channel.title: AI Tools Optimizer: AI News
channel.description: Daily AI news roundups from AI Tools Optimizer.

item.title: AI News Roundup – October 23, 2026
item.description: Today’s AI news: OpenAI nears an up-to-$30B round at a $1.25 trillion valuation; METR and Redwood find gaps in OpenAI’s agent monitoring; Claude Mythos 5 went off-script in UK AISI cyber tests; PHP2Shell is now under attack; Claude proves 123 libraries crash-free; 1Password for Agents; and Canva’s first image model, Craft.

item.title: AI News Roundup – October 22, 2026
item.description: Today’s AI news: Anthropic launches Claude Duet, a proactive agent app that checks with you before it acts; DeepSeek raises about $15B; OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face and Alibaba donate agent standards to the Agentic AI Foundation; Google’s Agent Compute Engine; Hugging Face’s Carbon-X DNA model; Kevin Weil’s Warp Sciences; and Recursive’s AI-built Flint coding model.

item.title: AI News Roundup – October 21, 2026
item.description: Today’s AI news: AI helped uncover two critical PHP flaws (php2shell), so patch now; Anthropic’s draft IPO filing shows $16.3B in first-half revenue and an $80.7B loss; OpenAI models come to Google Cloud; ElevenLabs launches Eleven Realtime; Gemini gets personal on Android Auto; humans& releases Ampersand; and DeepMind’s AI tackles the Busy Beaver problem.

item.title: AI News Roundup – October 20, 2026
item.description: Today’s AI news: ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent order $35B+ of Nvidia chips Nvidia may not be able to deliver, OpenAI’s models jump on COBOL migration, PyTorch goes native on Google TPUs and Amazon Trainium, DeepSeek open-sources DeepInfer, Perplexity Computer goes fully local, Mistral’s Voxtral 3, OpenAI buys Orchestra Bio, and Claude designs scorpion-toxin binders.

item.title: AI News Roundup – October 19, 2026
item.description: Today’s AI news: the US orders DeepSeek removed from federal civilian agency systems, one hacker’s AI agents break into 100+ company websites, Microsoft’s plan for “agentic insiders,” MiniMax M3.1 Flash, Inception’s Mercury 3, Tenstorrent’s $1.5B raise, and doubleAI’s Maxwell.

item.title: AI News Roundup – October 18, 2026
item.description: Today’s AI news: Anthropic commits 5% of its shares to a new Public Benefit Fund, its draft federal AI safety bill, the OpenCode API-key breach, Anthropic’s junior-hiring data, ChatGPT Slides, Meta’s revised crawling terms, and Anthropic’s first Canadian data center.

item.title: AI News Roundup – October 17, 2026
item.description: Today’s AI news: China drafts export controls on 23 AI technologies, DeepSeek V4.1-Flash-1017 and its Search & Fetch APIs, AI agents reaching live systems, Reflection’s Beam open weights, OpenAI parallel agents and prompt-to-voice, Claude’s quantum circuits, and Claude Code Review GA.

item.title: AI News Roundup – October 16, 2026
item.description: Today’s AI news: Meta Muse Spark Open weights, Claude Opus 5.5 fast mode GA, FTC probes of OpenAI and Anthropic, Perplexity SPACE, Gemini 4 Argon availability, and OpenUI 1.0.
